queries.sql: SELECT t.txn_id AS txn_id, t.memo AS memo FROM transactions t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id WHERE c.region = ? AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.channel = ? AND t.counterparty = ? ORDER BY t.txn_id LIMIT ?

queries.sql: SELECT c.sex AS sex, AVG(c.annual_income_usd) AS avg_annual_income_usd, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS _contributors, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.annual_income_usd IS NOT NULL THEN c.customer_id END) AS _avg_annual_income_usd FROM customers c WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.sex ORDER BY c.sex LIMIT ?
